howToPlay: Stay near your teammates to heal them with your basic attacks and Super. Use the Tuning Fork gadget for extra healing or Protective Tunes to remove adverse effects from your team during combat.
gears: Pick HEALTH and SHIELD to increase your survivability. Additionally, use GADGET COOLDOWN to use your support abilities more frequently.
trait: This brawler is ideal for players who prefer a supportive playstyle focused on team sustain and area control.
